WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `marketing:check` already gates that the SET of plan claims matches
per tier, and it cannot see whether a bullet's words still say the true thing. The same gap
opens the moment a second language exists: somebody edits an English string, does not touch
the other catalogues, and the Spanish page goes on rendering a perfectly fluent sentence
that is no longer true. Nothing about translation quality prevents that and nothing on
So `npm run i18n:check` recomputes the hash of the English string for every translated key
and compares it here. A mismatch is reported as STALE, by name, in CI.
STALE IS REPORTED, NEVER AUTO-RESOLVED. The honest interim behaviour is to keep showing the
last good translation with the fact recorded here, rather than silently reverting one string
to English mid-page. `npm run i18n:accept <locale>` is what a person runs once they have
EMPTY UNTIL A SECOND CATALOGUE EXISTS, which is Phase 3's state. The mechanism is built and
tested now so that the first translation lands into a gate rather than in front of one.
